meta.name: alfworld-object-state-inspector
meta.description: Inspects a receptacle's contents by navigating to it and reading the observation. Use when you need to check what is on or inside a receptacle (e.g., "what's on the shelf", "is the holder empty", "check the table for items"). Executes `go to {receptacle}`, parses the observation listing items present, and decides whether to take an item, search elsewhere, or proceed.

copy.tagline: 检查容器内物品状态，辅助决策下一步操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在模拟环境中导航并检查容器内容物
copy.tagline_en: Inspect receptacle contents to guide next action
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to navigate and check container contents in a simulated environment

howto.what: 安装后，当你询问容器内的物品时，Claude会先导航到该容器，读取环境反馈，然后告诉你里面有什么，并据此决定是否取物或继续搜索。
howto.when: 当你说出“检查架子上有什么”、“这个抽屉是空的吗”等询问容器内容的话时触发。

say.text: 检查一下洗手台上有哪些物品。
say.note: Claude会导航到洗手台并报告物品。

say.text: 这个马桶纸巾架是空的吗？
say.note: Claude会前往查看，若为空则提示寻找其他处。

say.text: 看看桌子上有没有杯子。
say.note: Claude会去检查桌子并告知是否有杯子。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask about the contents of a container, Claude navigates to it, reads the environment observation, reports what's inside, and decides whether to take an item or search elsewhere.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about the contents of a container, e.g., "check the shelf", "is the drawer empty?".

say_en.note: Claude navigates to sink and reports items.

say_en.text: Is the toilet paper holder empty?
say_en.note: Claude goes to check and suggests searching elsewhere if empty.

say_en.text: Look for a cup on the table.
say_en.note: Claude inspects the table and tells you if a cup is present.
